stage1.impression: A warm, coherent night interior with real atmosphere: fir ceiling, record wall, zinc counter and concrete floor hold up at 1:1, and the pools of light under the pendants and Orbs work. It still reads as CG. The rows of identical chairs, tables and Orbs feel like a showroom, the big smoked globe at top centre is a near-black blob cut off by the frame edge, the bright slotted patches on the right wall look like moonlight through a window that isn't there, and the EARF pair on the altar is small, grey-white and hard to read as the hero. A magazine would see a handsome but fairly generic bar; only the record wall and the globe begin to make it a specific place, and the globe is not yet legible.

blocking_9: Mother EARF must read at a glance as stacked, slotted smoked-acrylic discs with lit polished edges, not a dark silhouette (region [620,10,870,280] lum_p95 >= 90)
The altar pair must read as the hero: tinted acrylic cabinets with a visible surround, speaker region lum_median >= 45 with no clipping
The repeated identical chairs, tables and Orbs in the right-hand row need lived-in variation (props, a pulled-out chair, different glasses) so the room stops looking like a catalogue
The light patches on the right wall must read as the globe's cast pattern, not as a window
The Orbs must glow as frosted acrylic with a gradient and visible tint, not as flat white discs
The beams and ceiling should be warm but not the most saturated surface in the frame

defects.what: Mother EARF is almost black (median 8.8, p95 38.5). The disc edges barely catch the edge light, it reads as a dark mesh sphere, and its top is cropped by the frame edge
Hard-edged bright quadrilateral light patches on the concrete wall read as moonlight through a window and do not connect visually to the globe
The altar speakers are tiny and read as white boxes with a white woofer in black niches; median 37 and 44, below 45; no Smoke tint legible
The Orb lamps read as flat, near-uniform white discs (median 190), with no frosted gradient or smoked shell
Four identical chairs and four identical tables, each with an identical Orb and glass, in a perfect line: repeated copies of one model
Identical counter stools in a perfect row; the coat and props are not visible in this frame
The frosted screens read as flat blank grey panels (median 43, p95 55), like switched-off TVs
The large right-hand screen is a flat mauve-grey panel with a smudge; it reads as unlit plastic, not glowing frosted acrylic
The ceiling and beams are a strongly orange cast (r 70 / b 18), the most saturated thing in the frame, competing with the products
The banquette is mostly in murk (median 19.2) and its upholstery is barely legible
The concrete floor's blotchy mottling reads like wet patches or a tiled stain map
Visible fine grain or noise at 1:1 in the dark wood and wall areas

changes.problem: The room's centrepiece, Mother EARF, reads as a black blob; the edge-light test is not working.

evidence.measured: lum_median 8.8, lum_p95 38.5, crush_pct 8.4; disc edges show only one or two specks

change.to: 350 W, cone 25 deg, from [7.6, 0.6, 3.0] (further behind and lower, so it grazes the disc faces toward the camera and lights the polished edges)

changes.expected: The six disc rims glow as thin bright lines and the smoked faces show a soft gradient; the globe reads as layered acrylic, not mesh

changes.problem: The altar pair, the hero, is too dark in its surround and too small to read.

evidence.measured: lum_median 36.9 (left), 44.4 (right, region [655,360,695,435]), p95 238: hot batts in a black niche

change.to: 150 W, cone 45 deg, so the beam spills onto the niche back and the cabinet's acrylic edges instead of only the batts

changes.expected: The cabinets read as tinted volumes against a lit niche; speaker median about 50 with no clipping

changes.problem: The right-hand row of identical chairs, tables, Orbs and glasses reads as a showroom or repeated model.

evidence.measured: four identical chair, table, Orb and glass sets on one line, all chairs at the same angle

change.from: rocks glasses and coupe at the counter, coat over a counter chair (out of frame)
change.to: a coat over the nearest dining chair; a record sleeve and a half-drunk coupe on the nearest table; a different glass (a tumbler with ice) on the second; a menu on the third; turn the nearest chair 20 deg and pull it out 15 cm

changes.expected: Each table reads as a moment in an evening; the eye stops counting copies

changes.problem: The Orbs are flat, near-blown white discs that read as cheap globes, not frosted acrylic in a smoked shell.

change.to: 0.20 W, glow 0.0035, and frosted liner roughness up so it diffuses rather than flattens

changes.expected: The Orbs glow warm with a falloff toward the rim and a visible smoked outer shell; median about 140

changes.problem: The globe's cast pattern on the wall reads as moonlight through a non-existent window, not as the globe's shadow.

evidence.measured: lum_median 70.2, p95 158 in sharp quadrilaterals, about 2x the surrounding wall

change.to: 90 W, cone 30 deg, with a 0.1 spot blend

changes.expected: The pattern reads as the globe's slotted shadow on the concrete, quieter than the practicals

changes.problem: The ceiling's orange cast is the most saturated colour in the frame, which breaks the one-colour rule.
changes.expected: The fir reads warm brown rather than orange; the whites of the Domes and speakers stay neutral

changes.problem: The frosted screens read as switched-off grey panels.

evidence.measured: lum_median 43.3, p95 54.7: flat, no glow; the large panel [1080,10,1195,400] median 70, p95 97, mauve

changes.expected: The screens glow softly and evenly, with the image readable through the frost

changes.problem: The banquette side sinks into murk, and the frame median sits low in the target band.
changes.expected: The banquette upholstery and its timber rail read; frame median about 45

out_of_scope.request: Make the altar speakers larger in frame or bring them forward
out_of_scope.why: The room layout and the altar position are fixed, and this frame's job is the whole room from the door; it needs its own closer shot

out_of_scope.request: Vary the dining chairs and tables (mix models) to break the repetition
out_of_scope.why: The seats and furniture are fixed in the room's design; only props and placement can be dressed

out_of_scope.request: Show the Smoke tint more strongly on the speaker cabinets
out_of_scope.why: The products' colour and parts are fixed; only their light can change

out_of_scope.request: Lower the camera or widen the lens so the globe is not cropped at the top
out_of_scope.why: Allowed, but it moves every region, so no pixel test; worth trying 24 mm with the target raised to z 1.5 once the light changes land
